subject.title: fix(ui): neutralize Usage CSV text cells [AI]

question: Should Usage CSV prioritize spreadsheet-safe text cells by default even though affected exported labels gain a leading apostrophe in raw CSV consumers?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proven, but choosing between raw-data fidelity and spreadsheet execution safety defines a user-visible export contract rather than a defect that automation can resolve.

options.title: Adopt spreadsheet-safe default
options.body: Accept apostrophe-prefixed formula-like text cells as the default Usage CSV contract and merge once the owner records that compatibility choice.

options.title: Preserve raw CSV by default
options.body: Keep current raw text output and redesign the protection as a separately named spreadsheet-safe export path if maintainers want opt-in normalization.

recommendation.title: Adopt spreadsheet-safe default
recommendation.body: Accept apostrophe-prefixed formula-like text cells as the default Usage CSV contract and merge once the owner records that compatibility choice.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available low-confidence routing candidate from adjacent Control UI history; exact current-file ownership needs human confirmation.
